description: How long and tall a coffee table should be for a sofa, and how wide for the room. Length is half to two thirds of the sofa; height is 1 to 2 inches below the seat. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

length.description: Room length in feet, for the width suggestion. Optional.

seat.description: Height of the seat cushion from the floor, in inches.

sofa.description: Sofa length, or the long face of a sectional, in inches.

name: coffee_table_size
title: Coffee table size calculator
